replies.root_cause: Interface MTU mismatch on Gi0/0/1: local 1500 vs far end 9216 (jumbo per CHG-20914). Large BGP UPDATEs from the peer are dropped as giants, so keepalives stall and the hold timer expires. Fix: set mtu 9216 on Gi0/0/1 (or lower the peer MTU / clamp BGP MSS).
